requirement_snapshot.name: Tasks List
requirement_snapshot.description: Display a tasks area on the home page with the heading "Tasks" listing tasks from the database via a GET /api/tasks endpoint. Each task row shows its title. An empty state says "No tasks yet." when the table has no rows.

interfaces.name: App
interfaces.responsibility: Express app entry that wires route modules and serves the built frontend; additively mounts the tasks router under /api.
interfaces.specification: Registers tasksRouter with app.use('/api', tasksRouter); preserves /api/health, static hosting of frontend/dist, and SPA fallback; exports app for index.js and supertest.

interfaces.name: TasksTable
interfaces.responsibility: Idempotent creation of the tasks table during database initialization so the repository has a durable source of rows.
interfaces.specification: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))); runs inside startInit() on every initializeDatabase().
interfaces.test_focus: After initializeDatabase, tasks table exists; fresh DB has zero rows until seeded

interfaces.name: SeedDb
interfaces.responsibility: Deterministic idempotent seed of three task rows so the home page list has real database data after startup.
interfaces.specification: seedDatabase() runs INSERT OR IGNORE INTO tasks (id, title) VALUES (1,'First task'),(2,'Second task'),(3,'Third task') inside withTransaction; repeat-safe.
interfaces.test_focus: Seeding twice does not duplicate rows; seeded titles reachable via repository

interfaces.name: TasksRepository
interfaces.responsibility: Repository query that reads all task rows from the database in stable order for the tasks route.
interfaces.specification: listTasks(): SELECT id, title FROM tasks ORDER BY id ASC via db_runtime.all; returns [{id:number,title:string}] preserving DB order.
interfaces.test_focus: Returns seeded titles ordered by id; empty table yields []

interfaces.name: Tasks
interfaces.responsibility: Express router exposing GET /api/tasks that returns the task list from the repository as JSON.
interfaces.specification: GET /api/tasks -> 200 {tasks:[{id,title},...]}; errors delegated via next(error); mounted at /api by app.js.
interfaces.test_focus: supertest GET /api/tasks returns seeded titles; empty DB returns {tasks:[]}

interfaces.name: TasksSection
interfaces.responsibility: Renders the home-page tasks area: heading 'Tasks', one row per task title, and the 'No tasks yet.' empty state.
interfaces.specification: Section with h2 'Tasks'; success+empty renders 'No tasks yet.'; success renders <li> per task showing title; loading and error states rendered; aria-labelledby ties heading to section.
interfaces.test_focus: Renders heading 'Tasks', task titles from response, and 'No tasks yet.' when tasks array is empty

interfaces.name: TasksApi
interfaces.responsibility: Typed frontend API client function that fetches tasks from GET /api/tasks through the shared axios client.
interfaces.specification: fetchTasks(): apiClient.get<TasksResponse>('/tasks') -> response.data.tasks ?? []; exports Task {id,title} and TasksResponse types.
interfaces.test_focus: Resolves response tasks; falls back to [] when tasks field missing

interfaces.name: useTasks
interfaces.responsibility: React hook loading tasks on mount and exposing loading/error/success state plus a reload trigger.
interfaces.specification: useTasks(): {state: {status:'loading'}|{status:'error',message}|{status:'success',tasks}, reload} fetching via fetchTasks on mount.
interfaces.test_focus: Sets success with fetched tasks; error state on rejection; reload re-fetches

interfaces.name: HomePage
interfaces.responsibility: Home page route component that mounts the TasksSection inside the existing layout container.
interfaces.specification: Renders <TasksSection /> within main.min-h-screen > div.max-w-7xl at route /; unchanged shell behavior preserved.
interfaces.test_focus: Home page renders Tasks section heading and list/empty state through the real chain

interfaces.name: SharedApiClient
interfaces.responsibility: Shared axios instance with baseURL '/api' used by all feature API clients including tasks.
interfaces.specification: Exports default apiClient (axios.create({baseURL:'/api', timeout:5000, Content-Type json})) consumed by tasksApi fetchTasks.
interfaces.test_focus: Requests hit '/api/tasks' on the same origin as the backend-hosted app
